title: The Last Autopsy
author: Sable Okafor
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
